# T18 — load run (200 orders, 3 shops)

**Result: PASS** — generated by `scripts/verify-run.ts` on 2026-11-07T08:59:38.766Z.

## Setup

- API: `http://localhost:4105/api` (database `kagaz_rt`), DEMO payments (mock provider, no money moved).
- Run `2026-11-07T08-56-20-150Z`: 200 orders created through the public API (create → signed upload → upload-complete → pay), round-robin over `demo-shop-a`, `demo-shop-b`, `demo-shop-c`; mixed copies/colour/duplex/page ranges; 5 abandoned before payment; 25 with a concurrent double "Pay".
- Shops worked by `scripts/sim-agent.ts` (real device API: pairing, heartbeat, socket hints, accept/reject, lease, download + SHA-256 check, SUBMITTED → SPOOLER_COMPLETE, Mark Ready; randomized delays, rejections and print failures — nothing physically printed). Every READY order was then collected with its pickup code at the shop counter.
- Placement took 4.9 s; the whole run 100.1 s.

## Checks

| Check                                                        | Result | What was verified                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| No lost orders                                               | PASS   | 200/200 created; every paid order has exactly one captured (PAID or later refunded) payment and reached a settled state; unpaid orders never reached a shop. |
| No duplicate (order, attempt) print jobs                     | PASS   | 187 print-job attempts; ≤ 1 active attempt per order; retries only after a failed/superseded attempt.                                                        |
| No cross-tenant jobs or actions                              | PASS   | Printer, leasing device, acting devices (order events + audit log) and pickup device all belong to the order’s shop.                                         |
| Payments == paid transitions                                 | PASS   | 195 captured payments (PAID or refunded), 195 AWAITING_PAYMENT → paid transitions (incl. 25 double-clicked Pay).                                             |
| Order event chains are complete                              | PASS   | Every status change has an OrderEvent; each event starts where the previous ended and the last matches the order.                                            |
| Business rules (READY by operator, one-time pickup, refunds) | PASS   | READY_FOR_PICKUP is never a SYSTEM transition; COLLECTED orders have exactly one consumed code; rejected paid orders have a refund.                          |

## Reproduce

```bash
pnpm sim:agent -- --shop demo-shop-a --api <api> --exit-when-idle 60   # one per shop
pnpm load:orders -- --orders 200 --api <api> --collect
pnpm verify:run -- --manifest <manifest printed by load:orders> --out docs/testing/T18-load-run.md
```

## Notes (added by hand)

- Run on the realtime workstream branch (P2.9 + P4.7) against a local API on port 4105, database `kagaz_rt`, local SeaweedFS. One simulated printer per shop, so paid → ready reflects a sequential FIFO queue of ~65 jobs per shop (~1.4 s per job of simulated delays), not API latency.
- The 8 `NEEDS_OPERATOR_CHECK` orders are the simulated print failures (3 % rate). They correctly wait for a human: the needs-check resolution endpoint (contract §2, P2.11) is not in this branch; once merged, `sim-agent` calls it (`REPRINT`) automatically.
- The 8 `REFUNDED` orders are simulated operator rejections (3 %): each has a demo refund record (no money moved).
- The 5 `AWAITING_PAYMENT` orders were abandoned before payment on purpose: none has a payment, print job or shop hint.
- 25 orders sent two concurrent `POST /pay` calls: still exactly one payment and one paid transition each.
